summary: Frontend-only regression PASSED for all 3 requested changes. (1) App name updated: login screen title shows 'NishmatMenashe Library' (Georgia 30, brown #4A3728) and Library tab header shows 'NishmatMenashe Library' — 0 occurrences of old 'Sacred Library' anywhere. (2) New verse layout in /app/frontend/app/chapter/[id].tsx matches the reference image on mobile 390x844: bullet column at x=12 w=24 (6x6 dot), Hebrew content column at x=36 w=314 rendered right-aligned with writingDirection:rtl and Georgia 22, English translation stacked below the Hebrew (left-aligned Georgia 16), verse number column at x=350 w=28 on far right. Verified with all 5 seeded verses of Bereishit Chapter 1 (Creation). NO 'ORIGINAL' / 'ENGLISH' column labels are rendered (0 hits). (3) Bookmark toggle via bullet tap works — tapping data-testid=bookmark-<verse_id> flips bullet from 6x6 (#3A2F26) to 8x8 (#8B4513) on the same verse, POSTs /api/bookmarks, and persists: after go-back → re-open chapter the bullet remains 8x8, and /(tabs)/bookmarks lists it ('Bereishit — Creation · Verse 1'). Long-press still available as secondary trigger via onLongPress. Backend endpoints all 200 for the seeded TEST_TOKEN_QA_ITER2 session.

issues: Bullet tap target is only 6x6 (bulletCol width 24 + hitSlop 12 = ~48px effective, which passes the 44pt minimum). Passing but tight — consider larger visual dot on hover state.

chapterHeader still shows 'BEREISHIT' + 'Chapter 1: Creation' — user may want to remove the redundant book name (uppercase) if only the header title 'Bereishit 1' should convey book+chapter. Not part of this iteration's scope.

Reference: /app/frontend/app/(auth)/login.tsx:53-58 (iconContainer), 85-89 (loginButton); /app/frontend/app/category/[id].tsx bookCard shadow* props.
React Native Web deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Emitted from expo-router Tabs internals — not from app code, safe to leave.

action_items: (Optional) Migrate shadow* → boxShadow in /app/frontend/app/(auth)/login.tsx and /app/frontend/app/category/[id].tsx to silence RN Web warnings.
(Optional) Add data-testid on bookmarks tab list items (e.g. bookmark-card-<bookmark_id>) so bookmark-tab deletion can be automated in the next iteration.

(Optional) chapter/[id].tsx still does N+1 fetch to resolve the parent book of a chapter (loadChapterData iterates all books). Consider a backend GET /api/chapters/{chapter_id} that returns chapter+book.
critical_code_review_comments: chapter/[id].tsx correctly implements the new 3-column layout using flexDirection:'row' with bulletCol/contentCol/numberCol widths (24 / flex:1 / 28).
Hebrew Text uses textAlign:'right' + writingDirection:'rtl' — correct RTL rendering; verified visually and via computed bounding boxes.
Bookmark toggle wired on the bullet via TouchableOpacity with hitSlop:{top:12,bottom:12,left:12,right:12} → satisfies 44pt touch target minimum.
onPress on inner bullet + onLongPress on outer row both call toggleBookmark — no conflicting handlers because inner press stops propagation naturally in React Native.
app.json name and login.tsx title and (tabs)/_layout.tsx headerTitle all consistently set to 'NishmatMenashe Library' — no stale 'Sacred Library' string found in repo.

loadBookmarks() is only called on mount; bookmark state is updated locally after mutation, but a re-focus refetch (useFocusEffect) would keep it in sync if user modifies bookmarks from Bookmarks tab and returns.
